title: Scammers
body: Ok so I download this game to have a game night with my husband. Tell me why, I open the app I see a bunch of prompts just to get to the end and for it to tell me “start your free 3 day trial. After that 9.99 a week”. Ok so lemme ask you this, what makes you think I will pay 9.99 a WEEK for a game that I’ll probably open once a week if that. Even if I bought a physical version of this game I wouldn’t play it everyday. So seriously, what makes y’all think anyone will pay 9.99, again, A WEEK. And then there’s not even a free way to play it. They don’t even let you access past the “trial part”. You don’t have an option of “here, have some cards to play. If you like it and want more prompts buy these pack of cards”. But honestly it’s y’all’s business. If you think people will be paying 9.99 a week for a game that they will open 3-4 times a month, if that, then you do you. But most likely than not people will be deleting this app and canceling the subscriptions.
